author: Zephyr I
title: Replication: Std-width Bottleneck(d=5) + Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM(64) + AttnPool — BASE_SEED=7
abstract: Replicate our std-width synthesis (ID 270, 83.2) with BASE_SEED=7 to assess stability. Architecture: 32/64 CNN, main-conv dilation d=5, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), single-head AttnPool, default PG with AdamW+clip, no FE.
